## REC-DONOR-02C — resolved numerical deposition executed and published

[REC Draft PR #63](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rec_bianchi/pull/63) completes the bounded typed numerical adapter around unchanged COMSourceDepositionPlan. Current REC path: amended source protocol COMPLETE -> explicit-map component probe COMPLETE -> resolved numerical adapter COMPLETE on manufactured data. NO_PASS_REC_PHYSICAL_SPLIT.

Actual local source/test commit: `3a8e32c3b13054b8f0e71fc861a39c69aa8b1625`; tree `41aab828da46266dc53b5b1977fe6e8c064df22d`.
Connector source commit: `2eafa330b41b148531ddd9f0eee26636742a1f07`, exactly the same source tree/blobs.
Result publication: `3a988f3808b0e0a7800bfedd26d985b43e4b61d7`; tree `3f8e638377e4afa76c7028acfc079d99d570f615`.
Fixed parent remains PR61 `30576407d50e10b88a32b65a9510db61e4159e1b`. Native push failed once for missing shell credentials; the authorized connector published via non-force update. TESTED_SOURCE.bundle preserves the exact local tested commit. Documentation/metadata child commits were not numerically rerun.

Fresh execution: adapter 83 PASS; source protocol 27 PASS plus 9 subtests; deposition component subset 15 PASS. Total 125 top-level tests plus 9 subtests, zero failures/errors/skips. Fraction: 24 action + 24 JVP scalars exactly match; SymPy derivative residuals zero; five targeted mutants detected; two-process identities deterministic. Signed B/B2 occupation outputs differ by 0.75 s^-1 despite the same conserved moments. Actual residual PNG opened and visually checked.

One independent read-only reviewer found a P1 ndarray dtype-header identity defect. One bounded repair stores immutable bytes/shape and returns fresh headers/plans. Four regression cases and the final suite pass. This is an executed author repair, not independent post-repair certification.

Fresh general CI logs: runs33944081097/33944033851, jobs101246876921/101246750616 fail the committed-feature-range whitespace gate, before full pytest. First path: legacy rec_local01_admission/evidence/MUTANT_drop_density_jvp.log:6. All seven offending files are byte-identical to the fixed parent; no adapter path is implicated. No repository-wide all-green claim or unrelated hygiene repair.

[Checkpoint and evidence](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rec_bianchi/tree/research/rec-donor02c-resolved-numerical-adapter-20260905-work-r1/docs/research/rec_resolved_deposition). Only numerical execution is admitted: physical source/map authentication, moving-map/event JVP, accepted-state update, BASS wiring, provider, ready and merge remain withheld.

Single next task: prepare an owner-reviewable physical deposition input-authority contract tracing original HyRec packet channels, multiplicities and map/measure provenance to exact source bytes. This turn stops at the adapter checkpoint. REC-only append; other repository snapshots, issue statuses and official dependencies are unchanged.
